description: The function compares current spot price to stored snapshot.averagePrice, updated only when updatePrice() is called. If not called recently, the snapshot is stale.
root_cause: The function compares current spot price to stored snapshot.averagePrice, updated only when updatePrice() is called. If not called recently, the snapshot is stale.
fix_description: Require updatePrice() to be called frequently via keeper, or compute TWAP on-demand.
notes: Stale TWAP comparisons allow price manipulation to pass validation.
